_readme: Gutenberg batch of 30 popular public-domain books, verified absent from data/books.csv.

books.title: Common Sense
books.author: Thomas Paine
books.synopsis: A blunt, plainspoken pamphlet arguing that hereditary monarchy is absurd and that the American colonies must break from Britain and declare independence.

books.title: On the Origin of Species
books.author: Charles Darwin
books.synopsis: Darwin lays out the evidence for evolution by natural selection, arguing that all species descend with modification from common ancestors. The book that overturned biology.

books.title: Leviathan
books.author: Thomas Hobbes
books.synopsis: A bleak account of humanity's natural state as a war of all against all leads Hobbes to argue for an all-powerful sovereign as the only guarantor of peace.

books.title: Mrs. Dalloway
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.synopsis: Over a single June day, Clarissa Dalloway prepares for a party in postwar London while shell-shocked veteran Septimus Smith spirals toward suicide, their lives brushing without ever meeting.

books.title: To the Lighthouse
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.synopsis: The Ramsay family's summers on the Isle of Skye, and a promised trip to the lighthouse deferred by war and death, unfold through shifting streams of consciousness across a single decade.

books.title: Orlando
books.author: Virginia Woolf
books.synopsis: A nobleman who lives for centuries wakes one morning transformed into a woman, and drifts through four hundred years of English literary history. Woolf's genre-bending love letter to Vita Sackville-West.

books.title: An American Tragedy
books.author: Theodore Dreiser
books.synopsis: An ambitious young man's affair with a factory girl becomes an obstacle to the wealthy marriage he covets, and his half-formed plan to be rid of her ends in her drowning and his trial for murder.

books.title: The Sound and the Fury
books.author: William Faulkner
books.synopsis: The decline of the Compson family in Mississippi is told four times over, first through the fractured perceptions of the intellectually disabled Benjy, then through his brothers and a final omniscient turn.

books.title: As I Lay Dying
books.author: William Faulkner
books.synopsis: The Bundren family hauls their mother's coffin across a flooded, fire-threatened Mississippi countryside to bury her as she wished, the journey narrated in turns by fifteen shifting voices.

books.title: Elmer Gantry
books.author: Sinclair Lewis
books.synopsis: A charming, hard-drinking college football star talks his way into the ministry and rises through evangelical showmanship, hypocrisy, and scandal to the top of American religious life.

books.title: Arrowsmith
books.author: Sinclair Lewis
books.synopsis: An idealistic young doctor and researcher is pulled between the corrupting comforts of commercial medicine and the austere demands of real science, culminating in a plague epidemic that tests everything he believes.

books.title: A Passage to India
books.author: E. M. Forster
books.synopsis: A visit to the Marabar Caves ends in a false accusation of assault against an Indian doctor, exposing the racial suspicion and incomprehension underlying British rule.

books.title: Vile Bodies
books.author: Evelyn Waugh
books.synopsis: London's frivolous, party-hopping Bright Young Things chase gossip, money, and each other through a satirized interwar society hurtling toward catastrophe.

books.title: Point Counter Point
books.author: Aldous Huxley
books.synopsis: A large cast of London intellectuals, artists, and cranks pursue affairs, ideas, and betrayals in a novel structured like a fugue, contrapuntally cutting between their intersecting lives.

books.title: Vathek
books.author: William Beckford
books.synopsis: A cruel, insatiable caliph renounces God and descends through supernatural temptations toward the halls of Eblis, in a lurid Gothic fable of ambition and damnation.

books.title: La Reine Margot
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.synopsis: Amid the massacre of Saint Bartholomew's Day, Queen Margot of Navarre navigates a French court riddled with poison, adultery, and religious slaughter.

books.title: Camille
books.author: Alexandre Dumas fils
books.synopsis: A Parisian courtesan gives up her wealthy lovers and dies of consumption for the sake of a devoted young man's family honor, in the novel that inspired La Traviata.

books.title: Pot-Bouille
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: Behind the respectable façade of a Paris apartment building, its bourgeois tenants scheme, adulterize, and exploit their servants in Zola's dissection of middle-class hypocrisy.

books.title: Au Bonheur des Dames
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: A vast Parisian department store swallows the small shopkeepers around it while a poor young shopgirl rises through its ranks and catches the eye of its ruthless owner.

books.title: The Belly of Paris
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: An escaped political prisoner returns to Paris and takes a job among the market stalls of Les Halles, where gossip and jealousy among the fat and comfortable threaten to betray him.

books.title: The Debacle
books.author: Émile Zola
books.synopsis: Two soldiers endure the catastrophic French defeat at Sedan and the chaos of the Paris Commune, in Zola's unsparing novel of the Franco-Prussian War.

books.title: Three Tales
books.author: Gustave Flaubert
books.synopsis: Three short stories — a servant's devoted, shrinking life, a legend of a bloodstained saint, and the beheading of John the Baptist — showcase Flaubert's precision across wildly different registers.

books.title: Cousin Bette
books.author: Honoré de Balzac
books.synopsis: A spinster cousin, humiliated for years by her more fortunate relatives, quietly engineers the ruin of the entire family in one of Balzac's darkest studies of envy.

books.title: Cousin Pons
books.author: Honoré de Balzac
books.synopsis: An elderly, unappreciated art collector is circled by greedy relatives and a scheming concierge once word gets out that his cluttered apartment hides a fortune in paintings.

books.title: Dead Souls
books.author: Nikolai Gogol
books.synopsis: A con man travels the Russian provinces buying up the legal titles to dead serfs still listed as living on the census, in a scheme as absurd as the landowners he swindles.

books.title: The Overcoat
books.author: Nikolai Gogol
books.synopsis: A downtrodden copying clerk scrapes together the money for a new overcoat, only to have it stolen the same night, with ghostly consequences. The story Russian realism is said to have crawled out from under.

books.title: The Gambler
books.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
books.synopsis: A young tutor's obsession with roulette and a capricious woman consumes him at a German spa town, in a novel Dostoevsky dictated at breakneck speed to pay off his own gambling debts.

books.title: The Cherry Orchard
books.author: Anton Chekhov
books.synopsis: An aristocratic family returns to their debt-ridden estate and refuses to face the sale of their beloved cherry orchard, even as the merchant who once served them prepares to buy it.

books.title: Eugene Onegin
books.author: Alexander Pushkin
books.synopsis: A bored, fashionable young cynic rejects a country girl's earnest love letter, kills his best friend in a needless duel, and years later finds the tables turned. Pushkin's novel in verse.

books.title: The Queen of Spades
books.author: Alexander Pushkin
books.synopsis: An obsessive young officer schemes to learn an old countess's secret formula for winning at cards, with fatal and then haunting consequences.
